title: Korean Northwest Presbytery — Citation regarding Assignment from GA/Review of Presbytery Records
disposition_detail: The SJC accepted Korean Northwest Presbytery’s response to the exceptions of substance, subject to certification that Presbytery had approved it. The SJC also found that Presbytery had submitted its minutes and directed that they be forwarded to the Committee on Review of Presbytery Records.
first_summary: The SJC accepted Korean Northwest Presbytery’s response to cited exceptions of substance and found that it had submitted its missing minutes. The minutes were forwarded to the Committee on Review of Presbytery Records.
summary: Cited under BCO 40-5 for exceptions of substance and failure to submit minutes, Korean Northwest Presbytery provided an acceptable response and submitted its minutes. Acceptance of the substantive response remained contingent on certification that Presbytery had approved it. The minutes were forwarded to the Committee on Review of Presbytery Records, so the ruling established compliance with the citation rather than final approval of the minutes themselves.

sources.supports: Case identity, collective adoption, BCO 40-5 citation, cited deficiencies, conditional acceptance of the response, submission and forwarding of minutes, and vote.

evidence_notes.dispute: Lines 37–43 state that Korean Northwest Presbytery was cited under BCO 40-5 for exceptions of substance and failure to submit minutes.
evidence_notes.outcomes_and_reasons: Lines 49–53 accept its substantive response pending certification of Presbytery approval, find its minutes submitted, and direct forwarding to the records-review committee.
evidence_notes.qualifications: Acceptance of the response was expressly conditional on certification; forwarding the minutes did not constitute their substantive approval (lines 51–53).
